Note:
- Signed with the production Kuro Anime release certificate so it installs cleanly
  as an in-place upgrade over v1.5.3 / earlier 1.5.4-beta without wiping history.
- GitHub Releases and main branch remain on v1.5.3 (official public release).

What's Fixed & Included in 1.5.4-beta:
1. Fixed Theme Colours Picker (All 20 Accents):
   - Fixed a strict-mode ReferenceError (`host is not defined`) inside
     `theme-accent-1.1.js` `schedule()` that prevented the 20-colour Theme Accent
     picker (`#accent-111`) from mounting inside Settings -> Appearance, leaving
     only the legacy 8-colour dropdown. All 20 custom colours now appear and
     switch both WebView surfaces and native Android dialogs/bars live.

2. Fixed MyAnimeList & AniList Two-Way Sync:
   - Fixed episode watch detection across embedded iframe players (`megaplay`,
     `vidtube`, `vidnest`, `tryembed`, `hianimes`, `zorotv`), direct HLS stream
     playback, and native ExoPlayer so episodes mark watched & sync at >= 85%
     playback (including when closing the player after the ending credits start)
     instead of silently failing inside child iframes or requiring 98% end.
   - Fixed `TrackerSync553` progress advancement when watching mid-season or
     non-sequential episodes (`episodes.length() - 1` instead of stopping at
     episode 1).
   - Added automatic AniList + MyAnimeList ID resolution (`autoResolveIds154` +
     detail-page ID stamping) so titles watched from Home / Search / Browse sync
     automatically without getting stuck in manual `MATCH_REQUIRED`.
   - Routed `AccountHttp` through `KuroFastNet154` (Encrypted DoH `1.1.1.1` /
     `8.8.8.8` + pooled HTTP/2) so carrier DNS blocks never stall tracker sync.
   - Updated `Sync Now` and `putImports` to perform true two-way sync, refreshing
     progress & status on already-imported entries as well as pushing local updates.

3. Fixed Discord Login & Rich Presence Account Linking:
   - Added Android 15 (`targetSdkVersion 35`) `https` `BROWSABLE` `<queries>`
     visibility and explicit web-browser package selection (`openInBrowser154`)
     so the Discord Android app (`com.discord`) no longer hijacks OAuth URLs onto
     Discord's Home screen.
   - Wired Account Hub's "Connect Discord" button directly to native Discord
     Social SDK PKCE OAuth (`linkDirect154` -> `discord-1569077670074122250:/authorize/callback`),
     auto-enabling Rich Presence and updating the Account Hub live upon return,
     plus added token-endpoint redirect preflight & dual-URI callback routing for
     profile sign-in.

4. Buttery-Smooth Native Scrolling, Compact SUB | DUB Pills, Signature Violet
   Default, Smart DoH + Decoder Fallback, Multi-Layer Ad Guard, Android 15
   Edge-to-Edge Insets, Unified Account Hub, and 24 Manga PFPs & Banners.
